svg.title: M106 — Sparse bit-learning and dial-in grids / enhanced thematic plate
svg.desc: Fit simple frame positions, bit rules or mid/gap parameters to known sparse values and test whether they extend across puzzle keys. Original finding: Learn/test mid, gap, bit and frame variants; archived investigation reports poor known-key recall and no unknown address hits.
svg.text: Fit simple frame positions, bit rules or mid/gap
parameters to known sparse values and test whether
Bit-learning and dial-in scripts sweep bounded templates and report coverage. The later investigation
separates fitted tiny-key coincidences from actual unseen-address hits.
